narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -5.10 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 87.814-88.834 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 89.166; the first objective pays 1.90R at 87.430.

plan.triggerRule: footprint sdiv fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 89.166 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone

venues.reason: not applicable — Coinbase spot ticker is mapped for BTC/ETH/SOL/DOGE/XRP/LINK only

basis.coinbaseReason: Coinbase premium tracked for BTC/ETH/SOL only

notes: taker buyVolUsd/sellVolUsd = Binance base-asset taker volume converted at the perp last price
funding: venues missing from the OI chart were weighted at the mean OI of matched venues
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
